title: His father's fiddle playing and beating time with hat pins
summary: His father could fiddle for a hundred dancers from nine to one while the boys beat rhythm on the strings with hat pins.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
